specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 10000mAh Slim Powerbank, 22.5W Fast Charging, Dual Output Port, In Built Type C Cable, LED Indicator Lights

features: Built-in Detachable Type-C Cable – Always-on-hand charging; the integrated Type-C to Type-C lead snaps out instantly to charge Type-C phones, earbuds & tablets (no extra cable needed).
Cable Doubles as Carry Loop – Use the flexible cable as a handy loop to hang/carry the power bank on bags or hooks; snaps back securely into the body after use.
22.5W Fast Charging – Quick, efficient power via the inbuilt Type-C cable and USB-A port; ideal for fast top-ups on the go.
Dual Output, Charge 2 Devices – Power two gadgets at once: use the built-in Type-C cable + USB-A port for simultaneous charging.
Bidirectional Type-C (In/Out) Refuel – Recharge the power bank quickly through the top Type-C PD port, and also use it to charge devices.
10,000mAh Slim & Travel-Friendly – Compact, lightweight battery capacity for a full day’s backup without bulk; pocketable design with LED battery indicators.

Important Note( Dummy Type C Port)- The Type-C slot on the side is a dummy docking port designed only to park the built-in cable. It does not charge or transfer power/data. For charging, use the top Type-C PD port and/or the USB-A port
description: Portronics Luxcell UNO 10 is a slim 10,000mAh power bank designed around convenience—the inbuilt detachable Type-C to Type-C cable pops out for instant charging and snaps back to keep your bag clutter-free, and it also acts as a handy carry loop. Delivering 22.5W fast charging, it can power up modern Android phones, Type-C iPhones (with C-to-C), earbuds, tablets and more. With dual output, you can charge two devices at once using the integrated Type-C cable plus the USB-A port, while the bidirectional Type-C PD port on top lets you both recharge the power bank quickly and top up devices when needed. A compact, pocketable build with LED battery indicators makes it travel-friendly, and multi-protect safety defends against over-current, over-voltage, short-circuit and heat. Important note: the Type-C slot on the side is a dummy docking bay only for parking the built-in cable—it does not support charging or data. For charging, use the top Type-C PD port, USB-A port, or the included cable.
